rules.requirement: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too.

assertingTests.name: an illegal Butler vote is counted and only warned about privately (TB-BUTLER-01)
a healthy Butler's choice records the master, one dated effect, its note and one secret log line (TB-BUTLER-01)
a new Butler choice names the new master and leaves the earlier record to expire (TB-BUTLER-01)
an impaired Butler's choice is recorded with an effect that never applies (TB-BUTLER-01)
a choice the Butler made while impaired does not bind them once they are healthy (TB-BUTLER-01)
an impaired Butler's recorded choice replays to the same inactive record (TB-BUTLER-01)
the Butler choice reports the new master and the effect as command events (TB-BUTLER-01)
a healthy Butler records the master and is bound through tomorrow's votes (TB-BUTLER-01)
an impaired Butler still records the choice, as a suppressed ability (TB-BUTLER-01)
